hook.text: Released as volume 6 of the Polish Jazz series, every tune on it was written by the saxophonist who leads the band.

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Zbigniew Namysłowski (alto saxophone), Adam Matyszkowicz (piano), Janusz Kozłowski (double bass), Czesław Bartkowski (drums)

sentences.text: Wojciech Piętowski was the recording director for the album, and Halina Jastrzębska was the sound engineer.
Józef Balcerak wrote the text printed on the cover.
